Dr. Sam Parsno

Dr Sam Parsno has been trained by some of the world's foremost experts in advanced implant dentistry, including Professor Per-Ingvar Brånemark. With over 30 years of clinical experience, Dr Parsno has developed comprehensive expertise in implant and advanced restorative dentistry.

His formal training began at the renowned Brånemark Implant Centre in Gothenburg, where he completed his postgraduate foundation course in Implant Dentistry in 2000. He later achieved his Diploma in Implant Dentistry from the Royal College of Surgeons (FGDP) in London in 2011, followed by a Master's degree in Implant Dentistry from the prestigious Rey Juan Carlos University in Madrid in 2016.

Book Appointment

Dr. Yasha Y Shirazi

Having qualified from the University of Regensburg in Germany Yasha has worked as a dentist in both Germany as well as the UK. To Yasha, dentistry is very much a vocation and his calling. He is a firm believer in prevention being better than the cure and therefore is meticulous in spending time with patients educating them in the importance of good oral care.

Yasha is an exceptionally competent dentist and has a wide range of skillsets. His calm and patient manner is reassuringly welcome and very much appreciated by his patients. Yasha believes that dentistry is not only about treating patients' teeth but also about caring for one's general wellbeing and respecting the individuality of each person. No two patients are ever the same.

Yasha offers a full range of cosmetic and preventative/remedial dental treatment including complicated surgical extractions, complex treatments and smile makeovers, all with the highest quality dentistry as well as huge focus on aftercare to ensure the whole process is as comfortable as possible. Yasha is working closely with the team, he ensures all methodology is geared to ensuring the patient journey is perceived as caring as well as safe and concludes more than satisfactorily.

Dentist

Book Appointment

Dr Kamran Yazdi

Originally from Iran, I was awarded a Doctorate in Dental Surgery (DDS) in 2002. I moved to the UK in 2006 and sat the IQE exam to re-qualify to local regulations. I also did my postgraduate study here in London in Oral Dental Science (Diploma) and Conservative Dentistry (MSc) at the Eastman Dental Hospital (UCL).

I approach all my treatments in the most conservative way, that is to preserve as much of the the teeth as possible. I also believe that for the majority of problems there is more than one solution. Every patient is unique and it is my patient's right to be be informed and to choose the treatment which suits them best. As your dentist, my role is to be your trusted adviser. But the final decision about the treatment you receive must be made by you and only when you are completely comfortable with your choice. I spend extra time with my patients during consultations to make sure they fully understand the problem and the proposed solutions.

Some find visiting a dentist stressful but I like to make a good and friendly connection with my patients and aim to make your visit as calm and stress-free as possible. I also provide my patients with my personal mobile phone number so you can contact me at anytime if you are in pain or concerned about something.

The technology and science of dentistry is moving so fast but we keep up to date so our patients can benefit from the advances. We use digital radiography to minimize the x-ray dose patients are exposed to, 3D intra-oral scan to eliminate the old fashioned uncomfortable use of impression materials and needle-free injection system for overcoming needle-phobia. We also work with experienced dental professionals and technicians, using high-quality materials to ensure excellent results.

Dr. Andreia Phipps

Dr. Andreia Phipps qualified in 2002 in Fortaleza, Brazil. Dr Phipps is a friendly and enthusiastic dentist who believes in patient-centred dentistry, taking time to build positive relationships with her patients and helping to put patients at ease.

She is experienced in all aspects of general dentistry with a passionate interest in Cosmetic and Aesthetic Restorative Dentistry and Minimally Invasive Dentistry. She will be happy to answer any questions and is very committed to providing an excellent service to our patients.

Dr. Reza Davari

Dr. Reza is a caring and dedicated dentist. Having worked in both hospital and practice settings, he has developed a broad range of experience that helps him provide exceptional, well-rounded care.

Awarded the London Gold Medal for outstanding achievement, Reza combines advanced clinical skill, attention to detail, and a calm, gentle manner that helps patients feel at ease. He always puts his patients’ needs first and takes pride in delivering comfortable, personalised, and long-lasting results.

Dr. Narges Ameri

Dr Narges Ameri (DDS) qualified from Tehran University of Medical Sciences in 2012 and completed a four-year advanced training programme in Prosthodontics and Implantology, graduating with honours and top national board rankings. She spent seven years as an Assistant Professor at Tehran University, teaching and managing complex restorative and implant cases.

Now practising in London, Dr Ameri works with a special interest in prosthetics, cosmetic dentistry, and implant-supported restorations. She also offers smile enhancement treatments using clear aligners, composite bonding, and ceramic veneers. Known for her calm and empathetic manner, she takes time to understand each patient’s goals and delivers beautifully natural results with precision and care.

Jack Button

Originally from Brighton and now based in Tunbridge Wells, Jack is a highly qualified Dental Hygienist and Dental Therapist who graduated from the University of Manchester Dental School in 2013. As the Clinical Director and Registered Manager of South Kensington Medical and Dental, he is dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and clinical excellence.

Jack has a particular passion for hygiene therapy and is committed to delivering a first-class, comfortable, and personalised experience for each patient. He remains at the forefront of his field by continually updating his clinical knowledge and techniques through ongoing professional development.

He is also the only Dental Hygienist to have been awarded a Fellowship to the prestigious International Academy for Dental Facial Esthetics, an honour reserved for practitioners who have demonstrated exceptional contributions to their field.

Outside of dentistry, Jack leads an active lifestyle and enjoys running and playing rugby in his spare time.

Laila Alhussein

Laila is a skilled dental hygienist at South Kensington Dental and Medical Clinic. Originally from Damascus, Syria, she grew up in Dubai before earning a prestigious scholarship to study at University College London.

Dedicated to promoting oral health and patient comfort, Laila strives to create a warm, welcoming environment where every visit is a positive experience. Her friendly nature and genuine interest in people help put patients at ease, while her clinical expertise ensures the highest standard of care.

Outside of work, Laila enjoys yoga, pilates, cycling, and exploring London’s vibrant shopping scene. She also loves connecting with people from different cultures, which has made London feel like home from the very beginning.
